origin: Independent CC0 exposition of established quantum gauge foundations.
preparation: YM-F07, YM-F08, YM-F11 and the YM-F10 operator chapter. Haar volume, Grassmann algebra and BRST definitions are developed here.
proof_locators: Q.1–Q.8: original Gauss generator, compact-group volume and averaging projection
Q.9–Q.24: finite triangle, complete orbit slice and signed Grassmann determinant
B.1–B.14: active BRST signs, original gauge fermion, full auxiliary factors and elementary cohomology
B.15–B.25: actual convergent Ward integrals and bounded finite-order perturbation
F12.1–F12.20 and Solutions 1–8: physical states, exact finite spectra, moments and divergent asymptotic-series example

primary_source.title: Introduction to Classical Gauge Field Theory and to Batalin-Vilkovisky Quantization
source_locators: Nonminimal-pair equations s barC=B and sB=0
primary_source.exact_receiving_map: C_source=-c and B_source=i b. The connection is unchanged. Source sA=DC and sC=-C^2 become course sA=-Dc and sc=+c^2. Source s barC=B becomes s barc=i b.
not_imported: Continuum functional measure or Ward arguments
Source gauge-fixed action as a replacement for the original course action
primary_source.comparison_limit: The receiving Euclidean gauge fermion, factor 2 hbar/gYM^2, trace pairing and auxiliary integration are independently defined and proved; differential-algebra comparison is exact, with no asserted equivalence of unspecified measures.
primary_source.scope: Bounded original author TeX comparison; all receiving finite integrals and algebra are proved in this lesson.

conventions: Original active A^u=uAu^-1-du u^-1, kappa=-tr, sA=-Dc, sc=+c², all hbar,gYM,c_phys,metric and determinant factors retained.
owner_corrections: The compressed Wilson loop is a gauge-invariant operator; its two self-adjoint parts are observables.
The finite smooth partition defining the compact-group measure is constructed explicitly.
